import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from ingestion.wdpa_monthly.artifact_bundle import BuildStager
from ingestion.wdpa_monthly.resources import prepare_scratch
prepare_scratch()
path = Path(os.environ['TMPDIR']) / 'wdpa-staging-probe.txt'
path.write_bytes(b'WDPA scratch upload preflight\n')
stager = BuildStager.from_runtime()
refs = {slug: stager.upload(slug + '/staging-probe.txt', path) for slug in ('wdpa-marine', 'wdpa-terrestrial')}
print(json.dumps({'event': 'wdpa_staging_probe', 'scope': 'scratch-permission-probe-not-acceptance', 'state': 'succeeded', 'artifacts': refs}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
